purpose: Translate the complete foundational material baseline into Recipe roles, gain limits, scene fit, foreground/support policy, and routing risks.
hardRules: This map does not promote any item to production.
Finished content and router proof renders are not foundational inputs.
Noise, air, technical tone, and binaural-offset layers are support-only by default.
Sleep and Calm defaults must avoid drums, percussion, beat-forward groove, voice, choir, singing, chanting, and human-like vocal texture.
Medical, healing, brainwave, frequency-effect, and guaranteed-outcome claims remain forbidden.

Velvet Room Air A; Dark indoor room-air layer; no fan cycle, no motor pulse.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Velvet Room Air B; Even darker room-air variant for sleep.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Pine Air Haze A; Distant forest air without gusts, birds, insects, or leaf clicks.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Pine Air Haze B; Lower-brightness pine-air variant.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Far Ocean Blur A; Distant low ocean wash with no close splash or wave hits.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Far Ocean Blur B; Darker ocean wash heard as continuous body, not individual waves.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Rain Behind Wall A; Fine rain blurred behind a wall; no drop transients.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Rain Behind Wall B; Softer rain texture with less high detail.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Brown Velvet Hush A; Non-musical dark velvet hush; not marketed as therapeutic.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Brown Velvet Hush B; Deepest non-event texture for low sensitivity users.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Warm Pink Haze A; Balanced soft haze; kept low so it does not become the main content.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Warm Pink Haze B; Warmer and less bright than ordinary pink noise.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Low Felt Resonance A; Very low soft resonance with no phrase and no pulse.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Low Felt Resonance B; Darker low resonance for sleep support.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Dark Granular Smooth A; Fused microscopic particles, no sparkle and no rhythmic grain.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Dark Granular Smooth B; Darker granular cloud, background only.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Soft Bowl Tail A; Single soft low bowl tail, for rare transitions only.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Soft Bowl Tail B; Darker single bowl tail, no sequence.; route below foreground if road-like or mechanical association appears.
Soft White Noise; Broadband masking support with softened highs; avoid high gain during long sessions.; use as a quiet technical/support layer only.
Balanced Pink Noise; Neutral full-spectrum support for low-distraction masking.; use as a quiet technical/support layer only.
Soft Brown Noise; Low-weight masking layer for users who prefer darker noise.; use as a quiet technical/support layer only.
Deep Brown Noise; Darker low-frequency option; keep default lower than soft brown noise to avoid heavy masking.; use as a quiet technical/support layer only.
Dark Air Hush; Very dark support-only air layer; use under environment or music, not as the foreground identity.; use as a quiet technical/support layer only.
Soft Mid Haze; Soft mid-band support for calm/focus; avoids bright hiss and low highway-like rumble.; use as a quiet technical/support layer only.
528 Hz Reference Tone; A precise reference tone only. Product copy must describe it only by measurable signal parameters.; use as a quiet technical/support layer only.
Binaural Offset 6 Hz; Stereo offset signal only. Describe it strictly as a measurable stereo offset layer.; use as a quiet technical/support layer only.
